item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate state-transition requests against a supplied policy.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the policy decision without modifying either input.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    edge_key = f\\\"{request.get('from')}>{request.get('to')}\\\"\\n    edge = policy.get(\\\"edges\\\", {}).get(edge_key)\\n\\n    if edge is None:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"blocked\\\"}\\n\\n    required_role = edge.get(\\\"role\\\")\\n    if required_role is not None and request.get(\\\"role\\\") != required_role:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"permission\\\"}\\n\\n    if edge.get(\\\"retry\\\"):\\n        attempts = request.get(\\\"attempts\\\")\\n        retry_limit = policy.get(\\\"retry_limit\\\")\\n        valid_attempts = (\\n            isinstance(attempts, int)\\n            and not isinstance(attempts, bool)\\n            and isinstance(retry_limit, int)\\n            and not isinstance(retry_limit, bool)\\n            and 0 <= attempts < retry_limit\\n        )\\n        if not valid_attempts:\\n            return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"retry_limit\\\"}\\n\\n    return {\\\"ok\\\": True, \\\"value\\\": request.get(\\\"to\\\"), \\\"reason\\\": \\\"ok\\\"}\\n\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert [evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]==report; p0=copy.deepcopy(p); rs0=copy.deepcopy(rs); [evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]; assert p==p0 and rs==rs0; assert evaluate({'from':'x','to':'y'},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}; q={'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'admin','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}; assert evaluate({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'wrong','attempts':False},q)['reason']=='permission'; assert evaluate({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'admin','attempts':False},q)['reason']=='retry_limit'; assert evaluate({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'admin','attempts':-1},q)['reason']=='retry_limit'; assert evaluate({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'admin','attempts':2},q)['reason']=='retry_limit'; assert evaluate({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'admin','attempts':1},q)=={'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}; assert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready'},p)['reason']=='retry_limit'; assert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':0},p)=={'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}; assert set(evaluate(rs[0],p))=={'ok','value','reason'}\"]}}]}"}
